# Synthetic target fixtures

These targets are never deployed, uploaded, authenticated, or published.
`broken-plugin.zip` exercises real package errors. `desktop-stdio/` exercises
explicit desktop routing with the separate synthetic allowlist record.
`review-prep.zip` has complete synthetic review metadata; reserved .invalid URLs
are accepted only with --synthetic and do not assert reachable pages or video.
Fixture checks never establish host execution, partner eligibility or publication.
